maintainerRevisions.description: Flush-face fix by Claude Sonnet 5.5 via Claude Code (2026-11-12). Gatou cylinders (kawaraSlope helper, ShopEave/RoofFront/RoofRear): cylinderXGeo length 0.05 -> 0.054 so each round end cap stands 2 mm proud of the fascia faces it lay on (45 pairs); FrontFrieze: width 0.26 -> 0.262, centre +1 mm, front face 2 mm proud of UpperWall; SideReturn_L/R: back face 2 mm further back (width 0.22 -> 0.222) and top 4 mm lower (height -0.004) so neither shares a plane with CornerPost; BackBoard: length in z 4.6 -> 4.596 so its ends are 2 mm inside the SideBoard outer faces; CounterApron: width 0.10 -> 0.098, front face recessed 2 mm behind the Counter front; PostFooting_L/R: height 0.20 -> 0.204 (centre +2 mm) so the top is 4 mm above BaseRail top; Reveal_* (4): width 0.30 -> 0.296 so both x faces are 2 mm inside WallSill/WallHead faces; BackBand: height 0.10 -> 0.104 so its top is 2 mm above SideBand tops; NorenPanel_2: moved 4 mm along x so it no longer shares planes with NorenPanel_1; ShopEaveFlashing: width 0.10 -> 0.104, front face 4 mm proud of SidePlaster ends; WindowTransom: width 0.09 -> 0.094 so faces stand 2 mm proud of the mullions

historicalPosterReceipt.purpose: Gallery poster generated from the exact downloadable GLB; separate from authoring feedback.
